_comment: n8n nodes for Aria's CRM action tools. Open the Aria workflow → empty area → Ctrl+V (or right-click → Paste) → 6 nodes appear → drag each one's tool output to your AI Agent's `Tool` input. ARIA_ACTION_TOKEN must be set as a workflow env var or n8n env var.

parameters.toolDescription: Search the CRM for contacts, leads, or deals by name, email, phone, or company. Use when the user asks 'do we have a lead/contact for...?' or 'find me X'. Returns up to 10 matches per entity. Always call this BEFORE update_lead or move_deal so you can resolve names to ids.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('query', 'Search term — name, email, phone, or company', 'string') }}

parameters.name: entity
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('entity', 'One of: contact, lead, deal, or all. Default to all if unsure.', 'string', 'all') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Get a high-level snapshot of the CRM: leads by status, follow-ups due in the next 7 days, open deals (count + total value + weighted value), contacts by type, chat-thread activity. Use when the user asks 'how is the pipeline?', 'cuántos leads hot tengo?', 'qué follow-ups vienen esta semana?'.

Create a new contact in the CRM. Use when the user says things like 'agrega a Juan Pérez de Empresa X' or 'guarda este contacto'. Only first_name is strictly required — pass other fields when you have them. Type defaults to 'lead', source to 'manual'.

Create a new lead with full lead-scoring info. Use when the user describes a new prospect from a conversation, social signal, or scrape. Only `name` is required. Pass `lead_status` (warm by default), `lead_score` (0-100, default 50), `priority`, and `jung_archetype` when you can infer them.
parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "name": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('name', 'Lead full name (required)', 'string')) }},
  "email": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('email', 'Lead email (optional)', 'string', '')) || 'null' }},
  "phone": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('phone', 'Lead phone (optional)', 'string', '')) || 'null' }},
  "company": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('company', 'Lead company (optional)', 'string', '')) || 'null' }},
  "industry": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('industry', 'Industry (optional)', 'string', '')) || 'null' }},
  "jung_archetype": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('jung_archetype', 'One of: hero_entrepreneur | sage_conservative | caregiver_stressed | artist_specialist | ruler_executive | explorer_merchant', 'string', '')) || 'null' }},
  "lead_status": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('lead_status', 'hot | warm | cold | dead | converted (default warm)', 'string', 'warm')) }},
  "lead_score": {{ $fromAI('lead_score', 'Score 0-100 (default 50)', 'number', 50) }},
  "priority": {{ JSON.stringify($fromAI('priority', 'critical | high | medium | low (default medium)', 'string', 'medium')) }}
}

parameters.toolDescription: Update an existing lead's status, score, priority, archetype, follow-up date, or notes. The `id` field is REQUIRED — call Search CRM first to find it. At least one other field must be passed. Use when the user says 'sube el score de X', 'márcalo como hot', 'agéndale follow-up para mañana'.

Move a deal to a different pipeline stage. Pass `deal_id` (use Search CRM to find it) and EITHER `stage_id` (UUID) or `stage_name` (case-insensitive fuzzy match like 'Negociación'). Probability is set to the stage's default unless overridden.
